svg.title: How Plotwork works
svg.desc: How Plotwork works: 7 nodes, 6 connections. An AI agent, a CI pipeline or an import of source files sends Plotwork text to the engine, which checks it, lays it out and draws it; the picture goes to the README, Confluence and the team library. Nodes: - Plotwork engine (Checks, lays out, draws), service - Group: Write - AI agent (Claude, Copilot, Cursor), agent - CI pipeline (GitHub, GitLab, Azure), step - Source files (Terraform, SQL, OpenAPI), step - Group: Read - README and docs (SVG beside the code), client - Confluence (Only for its readers), client - Team library (Versioned, on brand), storage Connections: - AI agent to Plotwork engine: MCP - CI pipeline to Plotwork engine: Action, CLI - Source files to Plotwork engine: import - Plotwork engine to README and docs - Plotwork engine to Confluence - Plotwork engine to Team library
